violated_contract: A 5xx regression concentrated on one backend route must page even when the service-wide 5xx ratio stays flat. Cloud Run's platform request metrics carry no route label, so a route-level failure — including platform-generated 504s that never produce an application ERROR log — hides inside the service aggregate until a user-facing symptom surfaces elsewhere.
canonical_prevention: Provision a Cloud Logging counter over backend request logs labelled by method and a generic path family — optional version plus up to three complete lowercase segments, stopping at the first invalid segment — and page on every non-empty family above a sustained threshold chosen from measured incident and chronic rates. Shape-based normalization excludes mixed-case and digit-bearing IDs, but lowercase slugs and all-letter IDs remain a cardinality limitation. Reconcile without writes when metric filter/extractors and policy match; preserve the condition resource name when updating so unchanged deploys do not restart dwell. Provision from the deploy path without blocking successful deployment, while visibly reporting failure.
